# North East Bexar County Democrats (NEBCD)
# https://www.nebcd.org
# llms.txt — structured site context for AI language models

## Organization

Name: North East Bexar County Democrats
Abbreviation: NEBCD
Type: Democratic political club / PAC
Founded: 1994
Description: The oldest Democratic club in Bexar County, Texas. NEBCD raises funds, organizes volunteers, and works to maximize voter turnout across Northeast San Antonio and Bexar County. Open to anyone wishing to be informed or involved in local politics.

## Contact & Location

Address: 6521 San Pedro Ave., San Antonio, TX 78216
Phone: 210-917-1790
Email: info@nebcd.org
Hours: Monday–Tuesday & Thursday–Friday 8 AM–4 PM; Wednesday 8 AM–7 PM; Saturday–Sunday closed except events

## Treasurer / Political Disclaimer

Treasurer: Deborah Dillard
Mailing Address: P.O. Box 700766, San Antonio, TX 78270-0766
Political Ad Disclosure: Pol. Ad. paid for by North East Bexar County Democrats, Deborah Dillard Treasurer

## Site Structure

/             — Homepage. Mission, upcoming events preview, current endorsements preview, get involved section, photo gallery, office info.
/events       — Current events list and Google Calendar embed. Meetings, phonebanks, canvassing, election days, and voting resources for Bexar County.
/endorsements — NEBCD's current endorsed candidates for active Bexar County election cycles. Updated each election season.
/volunteer    — Volunteer intake. Ways to help: phonebanks, canvassing, data/admin, events. Google Form intake.
/store        — In-person merchandise at NEBCD HQ. T-shirts, yard signs, bumper stickers, buttons, flags, earrings. Pickup only at 6521 San Pedro Ave.
/sponsor      — Sponsorship opportunities for NEBCD signature events — Dining with Democrats and the Annual Labor Day Picnic.
/terms        — SMS Terms & Conditions for NEBCD text messaging program. (noindex)
/privacy      — 10DLC Privacy Policy for NEBCD SMS and digital communications. (noindex)

## Endorsements

NEBCD endorses candidates in Bexar County local, state, and federal elections each cycle. Endorsed candidates are listed at /endorsements and updated by the organization each election season. For current endorsements, refer to that page rather than this file.

## Events & Meetings

NEBCD holds monthly membership meetings on the second Saturday of each month, 10:00 AM to noon, at the NEBCD Office (6521 San Pedro Ave., San Antonio TX 78216). Additional events including phonebanks, canvassing days, and community gatherings are listed at /events and on the embedded Google Calendar on that page.

## Voting Resources (Bexar County)

Voter registration / polling location lookup: https://www.bexar.org/2229/Voter-Registration-Check-Polling-Locatio
Bexar County Elections Department: https://www.bexar.org/1568/Elections-Department
